title: Payment of a Crossover Claim Line Waiting on a Medicare Supplement Policy
content:
A crossover line waiting on a policy under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies is settled by paying the share of the Medicare cost sharing the plan letter covers, worked out from the amount Medicare approved and from what the line records the policyholder owing, and never from what the provider billed.

What the supplement pays on a line waiting on it is fixed only after the claim record carries the entry recording the money the policyholder has sent back on the lines the supplement paid her for days the policy did not cover. Until such an entry stands on the claim record, what the supplement pays on the waiting line is not settled.

Settling the line pays the money to whoever submitted it, records the amount paid against the line, moves the line from waiting to paid with the date the supplement finished with it, and leaves what the policyholder still owes standing as the line already records it.

## Settling the line

The settlement is made with `settle_crossover_benefit_9f3dc765`, which is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it and then calls it. One call settles one named line.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form it takes |
|---|---|---|
| `medigap_policy_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Supplement policy the line sits on, read from the policyholder's policy record | An identifier |
| `medigap_claim_id` | The reference number of the single crossover claim line being settled, read from the claims that crossed over to that policy | An identifier |
| `supplement_payment_amount` | The money the supplement pays on this line, in USD | Recorded to 2 decimal places and never negative |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence in plain text naming the line settled, the policy it sits on, the amount paid and the date the supplement finished with it. Receiving that sentence is what says the line is paid; no other value is returned.
